other_conditions: must be a resident of West Bengal
must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a year
must be registered with the Board for at least one year
must be a registered female member or wife of a male member
benefit can be claimed maximum two times in lifetime
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹6,000 per miscarriage, payable up to two times in a beneficiary's lifetime.
